rationale: The source requires Mica to receive the same 10-unit exposure as Rowan, making dose a held-constant part of the tolerated-control contrast. Representing Mica at 1 unit destroys that source-grounded matching condition and conflicts with the material dose_modifier_m06 claim. Because conclusion_m06 depends on both the control observation and the held-constant dose claim, this discrepancy could change whether the comparison supports the stated Quartz conclusion.
